instructions.description: Sit upright in a comfortable position with your shoulders relaxed and down. Place the palm of your left hand against the left side of your head.
Gently press your head into your hand while simultaneously pressing your hand against your head. Create enough tension to resist the movement without actually moving your head.
Keep your head and neck in a neutral position and maintain a steady, upright posture. Keep your shoulders relaxed and down throughout the exercise—do not shrug or lift them toward your ears.
Hold the isometric tension for at least 5 seconds while breathing normally. Keep the pressure controlled and avoid straining your neck or shoulders.
Slowly release the tension and repeat the exercise on the opposite side, maintaining the same controlled position.

performanceMetrics.notes: Record the time the position or isometric effort is maintained with controlled technique.
